theorems.name: Submission.bv_regularized_unit_field_admissible
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : Rn n → Rn n) (χ : Rn n → ℝ) (η : ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn n), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → ContDiff ℝ 1 χ → HasCompactSupport χ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x ∧ χ x ≤ 1) → 0 < η → (∀ x, g x = -(χ x / Real.sqrt (‖G x‖ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) • G x) → ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧ tsupport g ⊆ tsupport χ ∧ ∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ 1
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
